quotes.name: Evan Lewis
quotes.quote: You know, it's funny—on paper, the numbers look good, right? Better on-time stats should mean happier riders. But driving the route, I see it different. When they start tearing up streets for these big projects, people just... find another way. Doesn't matter if the bus shows up on time if the sidewalks are blocked and the air's full of dust. Folks in my neighborhood talk about it at the stop—they're tired of detours and noise, so they walk, bike, or just stay home. The stats don't show that frustration.
